Giver: Okay, I'm looking at my map. We need to get from the start over here to the finish over there. Can you see the start?
Follower: Yeah, I see the cross right in the middle-bottom.
Giver: Good. So, leave the start and go straight up.
Follower: Okay, going up.
Giver: And when you get to the top edge of the map, turn left and go all the way to the left edge.
Follower: Okay, left edge.
Giver: Then turn down. Just keep going down until you hit the baboons.
Follower: Wait, I don't see any baboons on my map.
Giver: Hmm, what do you see there? Is there a mountain?
Follower: Yeah, there's a mountain, but it looks like slate, not white. And it's a bit further right than where I was aiming.
Giver: Oh, okay. Ignore that mountain. Look for the footbridge instead. That's a better landmark.
Follower: Ah, there it is! The footbridge. Okay, I'm going down to it now.
Giver: Okay, once you hit the footbridge, turn right and go up.
Follower: Turning right. Going up.
Giver: Keep going up until you hit the old temple. It's a big stone building on the right side.
Follower: Okay, I see the temple. I'm heading towards it now.
Giver: Don't go straight to it though. Go just past it, then turn left.
Follower: Past it? How far?
Giver: About halfway between the footbridge and the temple. Make a little jog to the left, then head back down.
Follower: Okay, jogging left... down.
Giver: Now you're heading down. Keep going until you hit the abandoned truck. It's near the bottom left quadrant.
Follower: Wait, I see a truck, but it's lower down. And I don't see any baboons near it.
Giver: That's strange. Are you sure you didn't pass the baboons?
Follower: No, I definitely didn't see them. Maybe they aren't on my map?
Giver: Maybe. Anyway, ignore the baboons. Just find the truck. Once you're next to it, turn right.
Follower: Okay, found the truck. Turning right.
Giver: Good. Now go down until you hit the white mountain. It should be on your left side.
Follower: Wait, the mountain I see is on my right! And there's a white mountain way up near the top, but that's not near the truck.
Giver: Oh, hold on. Which mountain are you looking for? The one near the top?
Follower: The one near the top. But I'm near the truck now.
Giver: Ah! I forgot to mention the pyramid. You have to pass the pyramid first. It's near the top right.
Follower: Okay, I see a pyramid! I'm heading towards it now.
Giver: Go past the pyramid, then go left. You'll hit the cobbled street.
Follower: Okay, left. There's a cobbled street.
Giver: Go down the cobbled street until you hit the remote village.
Follower: Down to the village. Okay, I'm at the village.
Giver: Turn right. Go up until you hit the poison stream. It's right next to the village.
Follower: Okay, turning right. I see a stream next to the village.
Giver: Go past the stream, then turn left.
Follower: Turning left.
Giver: Keep going left until you hit the lemon grove.
Follower: Wait, I don't see a lemon grove. There's a banana tree though. Is that the same thing?
Giver: Is it a banana tree? Oh, if there's a banana tree, you must have taken a wrong turn earlier.
Follower: What?! I swear I didn't see a banana tree.
Giver: Hmm, maybe you passed it thinking it was something else? Anyway, look for the slate mountain.
Follower: Okay, I see a slate mountain. Where am I?
Giver: You are just above the footbridge. Go straight up from there until you hit the slate mountain.
Follower: Okay, going up. I see the slate mountain.
Giver: Turn left at the mountain. Go left until you hit the white mountain.
Follower: Okay, turning left. Now I see the white mountain.
Giver: Good. Go down from the white mountain. You'll pass the abandoned truck on your right.
Follower: Okay, going down. I see the truck on my right.
Giver: Keep going down until you hit the baboons on your right.
Follower: Wait, I don't see the baboons! They aren't on my map!
Giver: Are you sure? Maybe you passed them?
Follower: I definitely didn't pass them. I just see the truck and the mountain.
Giver: Okay, forget the baboons. Go down until you hit the banana tree. That's where you should be.
Follower: Okay, I see the banana tree! I didn't see that before. Okay, I'm at the banana tree.
Giver: Good. Now turn left. Go left until you hit the footbridge.
Follower: Okay, turning left. I see the footbridge.
Giver: Go down from the footbridge. Don't go all the way down yet. Stop halfway.
Follower: Okay, halfway down.
Giver: Turn right. Go right until you hit the slate mountain.
Follower: Okay, turning right. I see the slate mountain.
